column1: # bin/str_intermediate_ranges.tsv: the repeat ranges between normal and disease-causing that the report names (steps 09 and 09b).
# Read by bin/collect_summary.py. It sits in bin/ because bin/ is the only repository folder the report
# containers mount (scripts/24-html-report.sh and the Nextflow HTML_REPORT process).
# locus: the ExpansionHunter locus id (REPID). intermediate_min, intermediate_max: the range, in repeat units, both ends included.
# next_min: the first count of the next class, named in next_class; the range ends right below it.
# label: what the report prints beside a count in the range. citation: the GeneReviews chapter that defines the range.
# Only loci whose GeneReviews chapter defines such a range are listed. tests/test_str_ranges.py checks the rows
# and that docs/interpreting-results.md prints the same ranges.
